_readme: Sample inputs with the answers both calculators must give. The Angular specs (shared/calculations) and the .NET tests (WTF.Tests/Calculations/SharedCasesTests) load this one file. Change an answer here and both sides must change with it. Prices are pesos with at most two decimals.
